subject.title: test(media): cover filename control-character and bidi/zero-width sanitization

question: For this test-only media-store sanitizer coverage PR, should maintainers require additional real-behavior proof or accept a proof override based on source inspection and the targeted Vitest output?
rationale: ClawSweeper's external-PR proof gate does not treat unit tests alone as real behavior proof, but this PR changes only tests and the current source path is already inspectable.

options.title: Use proof override
options.body: Accept the source-backed, test-only change with targeted Vitest evidence once exact-head CI is green.

options.title: Ask for real proof
options.body: Require a small live or terminal run showing `saveMediaBuffer` returning sanitized IDs for the new filenames before merge.

options.title: Hold for owner review
options.body: Pause until the media-store owner decides whether this extra regression coverage is worth carrying in core tests.

recommendation.title: Use proof override
recommendation.body: Accept the source-backed, test-only change with targeted Vitest evidence once exact-head CI is green.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history owner for the current media-store sanitizer and original-filename test surface.
